name: Navigate portfolio sections from desktop
description: Verifies the main navigation and primary calls to action lead visitors to the expected portfolio sections.
steps: Select Skills in the main navigation
Select Contact in the main navigation
expected: The Skills and Contact sections are reached and their headings and content are visible.

name: Use the responsive mobile navigation
description: Verifies a mobile visitor can open the navigation menu and reach a portfolio section.
steps: Open the portfolio at a mobile viewport
expected: The Projects section is reached and the mobile menu closes.

name: Open professional contact and social links
description: Verifies visitors can access the email contact action and the linked professional profiles.
steps: Activate the Send an email link
Return and open the GitHub link
expected: The email link targets the configured contact address and the GitHub profile opens in a separate tab.

name: Review project and skills information on mobile
description: Verifies the skills and selected project information remains readable on a narrow screen.
steps: Open the Projects section and review the project cards
expected: Skill details and all selected project cards are visible without horizontal page overflow.
